explanation: Tea bricks served as currency in Tibet, Mongolia and Siberia into the 20th century. They were light and durable, and could be broken up to make change, or brewed.

claims.text: Compressed bricks of tea were used as a form of currency in parts of Asia.
Tea bricks were used as money in Tibet, Mongolia and Siberia into the 20th century.
Pieces could be broken off a tea brick to pay smaller sums, and the tea could also be brewed and drunk.
